summary: Nvni Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Alexandre Caramaschi as Strategic Advisor for Artificial Intelligence, effective June 2, 2026. Caramaschi, CEO of Brasil GEO and former CMO of Semantix, will advise on AI strategy across Nuvini's portfolio. The filing is an ordinary disclosure of a strategic advisory appointment, not a forced or abrupt departure. No financial terms, board recommendation, or structural details are mentioned. This is a routine update on a non-executive appointment, constituting a management change of low materiality. Watch for any future material impacts on operations or strategic direction.
